name: TC-03-financial-master-data
description: TC-03.5: Financial Master Data — Create account, cost code, and annual budget records

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Account List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Account. Accounts are used for financial tracking and cost allocation across maintenance operations.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — New Account
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create an account record. Enter the account name, type, and associated cost center.

steps.target: input[name='account_name'], textarea[name='account_name'], input[name='name'], textarea[name='name'], input[name='description'], textarea[name='description']

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Fill Account Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Maintenance Cost Account" into the Account Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Account Created
doc_metadata.caption: The account is saved and can be linked to work orders and purchase requests for cost tracking.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Account Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The account detail page shows the account number, name, type, and associated transactions.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Cost Code List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Cost Code. Cost codes categorize expenses for detailed financial reporting on maintenance activities.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — New Cost Code
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a cost code. Specify the code identifier, description, and category.

steps.target: input[name='cost_code_name'], textarea[name='cost_code_name'], input[name='name'], textarea[name='name'], input[name='description'], textarea[name='description']

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Fill Cost Code Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Preventive Maintenance Cost" into the Cost Code Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Cost Code Created
doc_metadata.caption: The cost code is saved and can be used in work orders and maintenance requests for expense categorization.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.5 — Cost Code Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The cost code detail page shows the code, description, and category used for financial reporting.
